currentCard.explanation: Сустав — место, где соседние кости или кость и хрящ образуют соединение. По степени подвижности суставы бывают неподвижными, малоподвижными или свободно подвижными.

literal.prompt: Как называется место, где соседние кости или кость и хрящ образуют соединение?

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: The English L30 definition exactly covers an articulation between adjacent bones or bone and cartilage; tendons attach muscle to bone (11.1 L30), muscle produces force, and cartilage is a connecting material in a cartilaginous articulation (9.1 L35). Thus the intended English concept has one key. However, the Russian key «Сустав» is given the full scope of joint/articulation, including immobile articulations: L40 explicitly includes skull sutures. This is the terminology defect D1, not evidence of a second correct distractor. All four labels are short, comparable nominative musculoskeletal terms.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Сухожилие — прочная полоса соединительной ткани, которая соединяет мышцу с костью.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: 11.1 L30 explicitly defines tendons as strong bands of dense regular connective tissue connecting muscles to bones. The note faithfully gives this own-option attachment fact; it is neither a generic label nor a false claim that the tendon joins two bones.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Сокращение мышечных волокон создаёт натяжение, которое передаётся сухожилиям для движения скелета.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: 11.1 L30 explicitly says tension from contraction of most skeletal-muscle fibers is transferred to tendons to move the skeleton. The skeletal/tendon context in the note expresses that pathway, without claiming all muscles move bones (L47 gives exceptions). It is a useful fact about the muscle option itself.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: В хрящевом суставе соседние кости соединены гиалиновым или волокнистым хрящом.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: 9.1 L35 states bones in a cartilaginous joint are joined by hyaline cartilage or fibrocartilage. The note teaches which cartilage types form that connection, genuinely about its own cartilage option, not a tendon or muscle claim. The phrase «хрящевой сустав» shares D1 because it translates the broad English cartilaginous joint category unqualified.

defects.kind: Russian terminology / scope of translated primary definition
defects.finding: English joint/articulation is an umbrella for all articulations, including the immobile skull sutures expressly named at 9.1 L40. CURRENT renders that whole category as Russian «сустав», then states that «суставы» can be immobile and labels a cartilaginous articulation «хрящевой сустав». In Russian anatomical usage «сустав» denotes the movable/discontinuous joint; the unqualified transfer of the wider English category is misleading. The primary context proves the breadth of the English category, not equivalence to the narrower Russian term.
